title: Markdown linting
description: Wraps rumdl over .planning/, README.md, and CLAUDE.md; verify:post writes a gate-readable violation-count report, ship:pre gates advisorily on it.

markdown-linting.enabled.description: Master toggle for the markdown-linting capability.

markdown-linting.ship_gate.description: When true, ship:pre advises (never blocks -- MDL-05 defers blocking to v2) on violation_count!=0 in LINT-REPORT.md.

gates.description: Advisory only (MDL-03/MDL-05): a nonzero violation_count surfaces a warning at ship:pre but never blocks. Deliberately not the sota-numerics onError:halt exception.
